neighbours.label: tokens inside Star Trek narrative (the Federation, Klingons, Enterprise crew, starships)
fire: After the treaty, the Federation and the Klingon Empire shared a fragile peace.
Captain Picard ordered the Enterprise to hold position near the Neutral Zone.
Spock raised an eyebrow as the Romulan ship decloaked off the bow.
The Dominion built its fleet faster than Starfleet could respond.
Data and Geordi worked through the night to repair the warp core.
The crew of Deep Space Nine braced for a Cardassian attack.
Q appeared on the bridge and taunted the captain once again.
Janeway set a course for the Alpha Quadrant and engaged.
quiet: After the treaty, France and the Habsburg Empire shared a fragile peace.
Captain Hughes ordered the frigate to hold position near the harbour mouth.
The admiral raised an eyebrow as the enemy ship came round the headland.
The empire built its fleet faster than the Dutch could respond.
The two mechanics worked through the night to repair the engine.
The crew of the lighthouse braced for a winter storm.
A stranger appeared on the deck and taunted the captain once again.
The captain set a course for the Caribbean and raised sail.

notes: Probe: Kirk/Enterprise/Klingon sentence 0.85, a ferry sentence 0.00. Near misses keep naval or historical narrative without Star Trek.
